'''Yonlach''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was confronted and defeated by [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] in the latter's quest to eliminate [[Jaesa Willsaam]], one of Yonlach's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]<ref name="defeat">{{TORcite|type=general|Guru in the Dunes|Tattooine}}</ref>.

==Biography==
Yonlach was considered the greatest teacher of his time and a valuable asset to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He had long been the very model of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]], a master of his emotions and unafraid of death. Though he had grown old by the time of the Cold War, [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was still strong with him<ref name="start">{{TORcite|type=general|Seek Answers|the Sith Warrior's personal starship}}</ref>.

Jedi Master [[Nomen Karr]] eventually brought Padawan [[Jaesa Willsaam]] to train under Yonlach on Tatooine, and during this period her gift to determine a living being's true nature first manifested. Through Yonlach's training she developed a strong bond with him, and he believed that her ability, if untainted by the Sith, would someday lead the Jedi to greatness once more.

{{GameDS}}
Eventually this relationship would prove to be a detriment to Yonlach, as the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] became aware of Willsaam's ability. In order to defend his spy network from the Padawan's gift, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]], who had once in the past petitioned the [[Dark Council]] to eliminate Yonlach,<ref name="start" /> [[Mission to Tatooine (Hunt for Jaesa Willsaam)|sent]] [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to kill the old master hoping it would draw her out.

Despite living a recluse life in the hostile [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], Yonlach was found and confronted by Baras' apprentice. He refused to give up Willsaam's location and was defeated in the following battle, together with his bodyguard [[Yul-Li]]. Unwilling to see a Jedi Master die for just a Padawan, Yul-Li gave up Willsaam's identity but the Jedi Master was able to stop him before he could reveal anything else. Yonlach then offered himself up to death, hoping his former Padawan would only feel peace and tranquility in his passing, but his enemy tried to break his will by carrying out the killing in a painful way.<ref name="defeat" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Yonlach was introduced in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within a series of quests in the [[Sith Warrior]] storyline. The Jedi Master's fate can vary greatly depending on the player's options: he can also die a peaceful death or be spared by the Sith Warrior.
